request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Geth Armature from the original Mass Effect 1, faithfully reproducing the attached actual in-game screenshot. Keep precisely this low three-quarter camera view and upright long-neck stance, the narrow head and bright blue-white circular optic, the long curved smooth silver-metal plates with dark gaps, dark mechanical torso, all FOUR articulated legs with their distinctive pale fin-like plates and pointed lower supports, and the hanging black cable loops connecting the visible joints. Preserve the source's particular proportions and visible leg overlaps, including the two narrower middle/rear supports. Do not substitute the much larger Geth Colossus or add its dark decorative markings; do not use the early guide design with a protruding cannon. No new weapon, extra legs, human hands, extra plating or invented mechanical details. Keep the source's subtle gray/pink reflected light and restrained original game-model surface detail. Match the exact pose and silhouette while framing the entire head, all four feet, armor fins and visible cables with at least 10 percent clear margin on every side. Remove the Citadel structures, stairs, sky, debris and floor shadow. Transparent background with real alpha. No terrain, floor, platform, text, border, collage or long lens flare; retain only a small blue-white bloom at the optic. Exactly one machine and one view; preserve naturally hidden rear geometry instead of inventing a different view.

notes: Capture finale ME1 inspectée : quatre appuis et tête entiers, jambes arrière superposées.
Armature grise sans canon de préproduction; reflet gris/rose de la scène.
Contrôle des différences avec Colossus requis; aucune échelle comparée ni partie arrière certifiée.
